description: Beyond Obvious is an answer API for AI agents: send one question and get an answer that goes past the generic one, with options and viewpoints a general model does not consider and a source for every number. Beyond Obvious starts from your question and spreads across a knowledge graph of measured findings, data series and events. Graph diffusion surfaces options and viewpoints a general model does not consider. Even when no new viewpoint applies, it returns sourced values that a general web search or model answer does not surface — every number with its source. Send only the question. Typically about 5 minutes; waits up to ~50 s, then returns an id (bx_...) - poll it with get_answer. Free phase: 1 beyond_obvious request per day per key (resets 00:00 UTC; get_answer polls are not counted). Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...); without one a new key is created and shown once. Usage is recorded per key.

api_key.description: Optional: your ak_ API key (identity; usage is recorded per key)

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait in this call (0-50, default 50)

name: beyond_obvious
